text: Being here, I feel a subtle anticipation and curiosity. The first scene has a sense of expectation, perhaps at the threshold of a gathering where ideas will be shared—hints of transition and communal energy linger in the air. In the second scene, enveloped by bright, deliberate design and the motifs of 'R+D', I feel the electric pulse of innovation and collective inquiry. The atmosphere nudges me to question, observe, and imagine possibilities. It is stimulating, a little disorienting, and invigorating.
